sql:
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS student_name
FROM event e
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = (
    SELECT link_to_member 
    FROM attendance a 
    WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LIMIT 1
)
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM budget b 
    WHERE b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
    AND b.event_status = 'MANAGED'
)
